scope: Read-only verification of merged V0.18.2 GitHub publication ZIP against newly executed portable tests, source provenance, evidence indexes and complete short staging inventory

checks.name: archive CRC, unique release root and safe nonduplicate paths
all release-manifest files and exact archive inventory
all current merged build inputs and outputs match expected publication hash
all vendored SDK files match recorded upstream provenance
every release-evidence SHA256 index entry is present and verified
distributed test-log copies equal actual source test-log bytes
new portable 17-check execution report binds this publication build
checks.note: A different archive hash is permitted only when next check proves all tested source and runtime bytes identical, e.g. added final reports.

checks.name: all final source and executable files equal newly runtime-tested files
development dependencies, wallet secrets and model weights excluded
all allowed files from fresh short staging are included without path omissions

priorVersionEvidence: Existing older reports may remain historical; this verification requires a new publicationVerification=true portable report bound to the merged build.
